$schema: one canonical copy source — see README.md. Edit this file, then `npm run build`.

gradedSlab.title: Verify graded
gradedSlab.confirmFooterPsa: Only confirm if the details above match the physical slab in your hand. This is what marks the card graded and lets it be listed as graded.
gradedSlab.certNotFoundBody: No PSA record found for that cert number — double-check the digits on the label. (CGC and the other graders have no public cert API; their label reading is used as-is once you confirm it.)

gradedSlab.scanFailed: Couldn't read the label. Try again with the printed strip filling the frame, or type the details in below.
